 TV Tatyana Ali and Alfonso Ribeiro Bring the Tears and Smiles Honoring Late James Avery During ‘DWTS’ Dedication Night
 The former co-stars and friends paid tribute to their on-screen “Fresh Prince” father. Updated   Oct. 20, 2026, 8:29 PM EDT / Source : TODAY Liz Calvario
 Senior Editor
 ‘Fresh Prince of Bel-Air’ reunion releases 1st trailer 01:04 Share Add TODAY to Google Tatyana Ali brought all the feels to the “Dancing With the Stars” ballroom floor on Dedication Night. 
 The actor and partner Jan Ravnik performed a Viennese waltz to “(You Don’t Know) How Glad I Am” by Nancy Wilson to honor the late James Avery during the Oct. 20 episode. 
 Avery portrayed Ali and “DWTS” co-host Alfonso Ribeiro’s on-screen father Philip Banks for six seasons on “The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air” from 1990 to 1996.
 The routine was extra special as Ribeiro joined his TV sister and longtime friend on the dance floor for a special one-on-one moment that got the crowd emotional. 
 Calling him a “father figure,” Ali expressed her love for Avery during rehearsals. “I loved him a lot.”
 Ali began her performance wearing a gorgeous peach-colored gown while seated on a couch. Ravnik then swept her on her feet as they elegantly waltzed across the floor. Midway through her performance, Ribeiro, who won Season 19 of “DWTS,” joined her as they closed the routine. 
 Tatyana Ali and Alfonso Ribeiro after their "DWTS" Dedication Night performance on Oct. 20. ABC Their performance ended with the two holding hands and embracing as a photo of Avery was seen on the screen behind them. 
 The judges praised their heartfelt routine, with Carrie Ann Inaba saying she felt honored to witness the longtime friends dancing together. 
 The couple received a 32 out of 40, their best scores of the night. 
 Tatyana Ali and Alfonso Ribeiro honored their late co-star and TV father James Avery. ABC Days before Dedication Night, Ali revealed that she would actually be singing Wilson’s song and dance to a pre-recorded version of it. 
 “We’re dancing to a Nancy Wilson song that I’m going to sing. I’m going to pre-record it,” she shared . “And I just hope ... you all feel how much that we love him.”
 She said that Avery was a “lover of jazz” and that Wilson was one of his favorite artists. 
 “James Avery played Uncle Phil on ‘The Fresh Prince of Bel Air.’ He means a lot to fans of the show. He meant a lot to me. He was a mentor to me, a teacher to me,” Ali said in the video. “He was the heart of our show in so many ways. He loved the arts, and he taught me about all of the artists he thought I needed to know.”
 “I wouldn’t be who I am today as a performer, as a woman, without him being in my life. And I want to honor him,” she continued. “I get to perform with Alfonso to honor James.”
 “The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air” followed Will Smith as he moved from West Philadelphia to his rich relatives’ Bel-Air mansion. Ali’s Ashley and Ribeiro’s Carlton were Will’s cousins. 
 Avery’s Uncle Phil was the stern, yet loving father figure Will always needed. The iconic actor died at the age of 68 in 2013.
